title: Discount Horizon Schedule for Later Distribution-Margin Allocations Retired for an Estate (Capital Credits)
content:
# Discount Horizon Schedule — Later Allocations Retired for an Estate

**Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) schedule.** The estate discount horizon of a later distribution-margin row is its whole years from rotation — the whole years from the calendar year of the retirement to its allocation year plus the class's expected rotation years, never fewer than zero — transformed as follows:

| Whole years from rotation | Horizon over which the row is discounted |
|---|---|
| 20 or more | 20 years only |
| 3 to 19 | its whole years |
| 2 or fewer | none — the row is not discounted at all |

## Edges of the schedule (hypothetical rows)

| Whole years from rotation | Horizon |
|---|---|
| 23 | 20 years |
| 20 | 20 years |
| 19 | 19 years |
| 3 | 3 years |
| 2 | none |
| 0 | none |

The horizon is always a whole number of years for these rows; no part year is counted.
